turnos.t: Is pulling out of a country always the responsible choice?

Take Disney. In 2012, factory fires in Karachi and Dhaka killed hundreds of garment workers. In March 2013, Disney told its licensees to stop making Disney products in Bangladesh and four other countries.
That protected the brand. But what about the workers?
That's the debate. Critics said leaving removes jobs instead of improving factories. Others saw a responsible refusal to profit from unsafe work. In an evaluation, use both views.
